text: Vedanta Oil and Gas lost an oil field to ONGC. Output fell nineteen percent. But the lost field isn't the main reason.
Daily output: seventy two point two thousand barrels, down from eighty nine point one. A drop of sixteen point nine.
Cambay, the field ONGC took over, fell by five point four.
Rajasthan, its biggest field, fell by eleven. The company calls it natural decline.
So Rajasthan is about two thirds of the fall. Cambay, about one third.
And Rajasthan is eighty three percent of what it produces. How long does that contract run? The filings we read don't say. Back to the napkin.
